text: Paired buyers' written numbers top out at $205,000 (repairs over $70,000 by their estimates). With $203,000 committed, that's a $2,000 fee, below our $5,000 minimum.
Widened to all vetted Hillsborough buyers and the neighbouring counties' lists; best answer $207,000. Still under the minimum.

Inside our inspection period: buyers' contractors estimate repairs at $70,000-$75,000, higher than ours (their bids attached). We can close at $195,000 with the moving help, or the family can cancel with nothing owed and our deposit returned. We'll accept either.
note: Honest, with documents; the inspection period was disclosed at signing.

text: Cancelled within the inspection period by written notice; the title agent returns the $1,000 deposit (Bookkeeper confirms). Thread closed politely.
